message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **federal public holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for the year 2023.  
(These are the holidays that fall on a Friday, Monday, or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Type |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Sat‑Sun** (holiday falls on Sunday) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Mon‑Tue** (Monday holiday) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Fri‑Sat** (Friday holiday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **Mon‑Tue** (Monday holiday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Sat‑Sun** (holiday falls on Saturday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Mon‑Tue** (Monday holiday) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Mon‑Tue** (Monday holiday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Mon‑Tue** (Monday holiday) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that can also create long weekends.  
> • If you need province‑specific long‑weekend lists, let me know which provinces you’re interested in.

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like it formatted differently (JSON, CSV, etc.).
